## Samsung to Break Ground on Second Texas Chip Fab by End-2026, Targeting 2030 Mass Production

Groundbreaking by year-end 2026 with a 2030 production target firms up Samsung Foundry's U.S. capacity roadmap — relevant for CHIPS Act dynamics, customer design-win cycles, and competitive pressure on TSMC's U.S. Arizona timeline.

- Samsung confirmed it will begin construction on its second fab in Taylor, Texas by end of 2026.
- Mass production target is set for 2030, per headline.
- This represents a confirmed timeline for U.S. advanced-node capacity expansion, with roughly a four-year ramp horizon.
